release_name: PUBLIC BLACK/RED SWEEP + UNIFIED MENU + MERCH CHECKOUT FIX
description: Removes remaining beige public surfaces, standardises the Explore menu, and replaces Safari fetch checkout with a robust same-origin form POST to SumUp.
changes: Scanned and overridden remaining beige/cream public-facing cards, forms, filters and panels
Homepage Explore menu now uses the same text-only professional menu as inner pages
Merch checkout now submits as a normal form POST for iPhone Safari reliability
Worker accepts JSON and form-encoded merch orders and redirects securely to hosted SumUp checkout
Mobile and desktop layout fixes from v96.4.38 preserved
HQ paid revenue now combines paid class bookings and paid merchandise orders.
HQ overview shows class revenue, merchandise revenue and estimated merchandise profit separately.
Merch Orders shows estimated production cost and item profit using £12 unisex and £17 women’s premium production costs.
Class editor now includes reusable Edgbaston Community Centre and Low Places Bar templates with venue address, usual times, capacity and concise first-class guidance.
HQ cream/beige admin panels were converted to the black/red/cream brand palette.
Homepage opening headline now uses the Western Rye display type selectively.
HQ refresh reconciles pending SumUp merchandise checkouts so paid T-shirt sales appear in revenue even if the customer did not return to the website after payment.
notes: Homepage story sections restored; HQ dark sweep; iOS HQ drawer scroll fix; pre-live pending merch test cleanup.
desktop_layout_repair: MacBook/small desktop breakpoint repair; mobile below 768px preserved
name: HQ-REVENUE-VENUE-TEMPLATES-DARK-SWEEP
